name: Peter Njenga Kihoro
headline: Computer Programmer, Project Management Specialist, ICT Support Specialist, and Creative Professional
aboutIntro: I am Peter Njenga Kihoro, a software developer, project management specialist, and creative professional based in California. I build web, desktop, and Android applications that turn everyday workflows into practical tools for businesses and communities.
bio: My work spans hospital workflows, church administration, cleaning marketplaces, retail storefronts, and dealership systems. I bring together application development, database design, ICT support, and project planning, alongside graphic design, video editing, and music production.
aboutPageSubtitle: Software development, project planning, ICT support, and creative work.
contactPageSubtitle: Get in touch for any services you may require at very affordable rates
resumeProfile: Innovative and deadline-driven Web Developer, Android Developer, Graphic Designer, and Video Editor with 3+ years of experience designing user-centered digital and print material.

services.title: Web Applications & Websites
services.description: Responsive websites, storefronts, customer portals, and marketplaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js. My projects include Kabo, CleanConnect, and Edwin’s Auto Hub.

services.title: Business & Community Systems
services.description: Custom tools for registration, inventory, appointments, reporting, and administration. I build shared workflows, role-based access, and database-backed dashboards, as demonstrated by Carepoint Hospital IMS and VWO Karati.

services.title: Android & Desktop Applications
services.description: Android applications with Java and Kotlin, and desktop tools using Python/Tkinter and Electron. Examples include Status Gallery and Church Member Registration, with local file handling, search, and data exports.

services.title: Database & Backend Development
services.description: Node.js APIs and SQLite or MongoDB data storage, with authentication, validation, permissions, and reporting. I connect public interfaces and staff dashboards to a shared source of data.

services.title: Project Planning & Coordination
services.description: Requirements gathering, scope definition, task planning, documentation, and delivery coordination, informed by my postgraduate training in Project Management & Planning.

services.title: ICT Support & System Administration
services.description: Technical troubleshooting, user support, server maintenance, and network configuration, drawing on my experience supporting ICT systems in a hospital environment.

services.title: Graphic Design & Video Editing
services.description: Brand graphics, marketing materials, and edited video content using Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and CapCut. I also support OBS-based streaming and content preparation.

services.title: Music & Digital Content
services.description: Instrumental and theme music production in FL Studio, plus writing and social media content support for individuals, businesses, and community organizations.

projects.title: Carepoint Hospital IMS
projects.description: A hospital management system with shared browser and Electron interfaces. Implements staff roles, patient registration, appointments, clinical encounters, lab and pharmacy orders, billing, and inpatient bed allocation. Production release and cross-site data exchange remain in development.
projects.imageAlt: Carepoint Hospital IMS — illustrated project preview

projects.title: CleanConnect
projects.description: A two-sided cleaning marketplace with customer and cleaner accounts, service profiles, job postings, competitive offers, hiring, job messages, and reviews. Includes Stripe Checkout and Connect integration; live payments require production configuration.

projects.title: Edwin’s Auto Hub
projects.description: A dealership and multi-category catalogue for cars, parts, land, and houses. Includes search, saved listings, enquiries, seller submissions, inventory management, customer follow-ups, viewing schedules, and sales reports.
projects.imageAlt: Edwin’s Auto Hub — illustrated project preview

projects.title: Church Member Registration
projects.description: A desktop member registration system with authentication, photo uploads, search and filtering, dashboard charts, backups, session timeouts, and Excel and PDF exports.
projects.imageAlt: Church Member Registration — illustrated project preview

projects.title: Personal Profile & Portfolio
projects.description: This responsive portfolio presents my background, services, and projects. The Node version includes a protected profile editor and supports MongoDB or local JSON storage; the public GitHub Pages version uses the saved profile data.
projects.imageAlt: Personal Profile & Portfolio — illustrated project preview

projects.title: VWO Karati Church System
projects.description: A public church website and shared office portal with a Windows desktop launcher. Includes member registration, attendance, care tasks, reports, staff permissions, website publishing, and administrator backups.
projects.imageAlt: VWO Karati Church System — illustrated project preview

projects.title: Kabo Crochet Storefront
projects.description: A crochet storefront and studio dashboard with search, product galleries, a stock-aware cart, customer accounts, order history, discounts, inventory management, and order tracking. Checkout creates demo orders; payments are not connected.
projects.imageAlt: Kabo Crochet Storefront — illustrated project preview

projects.title: Status Gallery
projects.description: An Android gallery for locally available WhatsApp status photos and videos. Includes filters, full-screen viewing, saving copies, multi-selection, and manual person groups. Uses Android folder permissions without network access; currently a sideloaded prototype.
projects.technologies: Java · Android SDK · Storage Access Framework
